messages:
Maya T.: Heads up: ACME asked for a 'Performance Onramp' add-on that bundles per-route reserved throughput, burst credits, and regional egress controls. They want a pilot and a pricing proposal this sprint.
Liam H.: recap of asks from customer call: sustained 150-200 rps/route, 8k-12k burst credits per month, ability to lock egress to specific regions, and a pilot SLA for p99 tail.
Nora V.: engineering reality check: to safely guarantee per-route sustained RPS we need dedicated routing + pool isolation. That means a reserved pool or strong quota throttles per route. Effort estimate: infra + QA ~10 dev days; plus config templating for customers.
Omar S.: product suggestion: make the add-on a toggle with three strata: Standard (soft-reserve + burst), Guaranteed (dedicated pool + SLA), Pilot (time-limited reduced fee with conditions). Keeps options for negotiation.
Priya R.: finance: propose pilot pricing example: Pilot fee $2,000/mo (90 days) with included 5k burst credits, overage $0.01/req over reserved. Conversion to Guaranteed: $6,000/mo reserved + $500 per additional 10k burst credits. Need to model expected utilization.
Nora V.: for Pilot we can implement using feature-flagged config and route labels. Sample config for ops:
```
routes:
  - name: acme-checkout
    perf_onramp: pilot
    reserved_rps: 150
    burst_credits: 8000
    egress_regions: [us-west-2]
```
We'll include canary and kill-switch hooks.
qa-bot: qa-bot: perf test scheduled: perf-onramp-acme -> planned, expected runtime 4h.
Maya T.: legal flags: regional egress whitelisting is OK for pilot but require explicit addendum; cannot promise global SLA. Also need customer to accept capacity carveouts and maintenance windows.
Liam H.: ops note: support readiness requires an on-call runbook, an incident playbook for degraded throughput, and a dashboard with per-route burn rate and latency quantiles.
Priya R.: also recommend a pilot conversion clause: if ACME converts within 30 days after pilot, apply 15% credit of pilot fees toward the first month of Guaranteed. Also require 30 days notice for pilot termination.
Maya T.: Proposed launch criteria (must pass all): 1) Perf harness proves sustained reserved_rps for 48h under ACME-like mix with p95 < 200ms and p99 < 500ms in single region; 2) Pilot commercial approved by Finance; 3) Pilot addendum signed by Legal; 4) Support runbook + dashboard published; 5) Canary rollout in staging and one-week soak.
Omar S.: agree. Also add a rollback policy: automatic fallback to soft-reserve mode if p99 > 2s for > 10m. Include a throttle-based protection if backend utilization hits 90%.
Nora V.: I'll own the perf harness and the kill-switch. ETA 8 business days.
Priya R.: I'll deliver the pilot pricing sheet and conversion clause draft. ETA 3 business days.
Maya T.: Legal, can you get pilot addendum draft in 4 days?
Maya T.: Support, ETA for runbook + dashboard widgets?
Liam H.: Support ETA 6 business days for runbook and dashboard examples.
Maya T.: OK. We won't commit to cross-region SLA for pilot; single-region only. Everyone good?
All: thumbs up / agreed.
Maya T.: I'll summarize and send to ACME with a proposed pilot term and timeline. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
notes: Short Slack thread capturing cross-functional scoping for a pricing/packaging pilot add-on focused on reserved throughput, burst credits, and egress controls. Contains action owners and launch criteria.
